explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. Both `machineKuhnBuildChosenMate` and the class `Complexity.FP` are defined in the library itself. `FP` comes from the bundled Complexitylib, in `LeanPool/BeyondBethe/Complexitylib/Classes/P/Defs.lean`, not from Mathlib. The theorem says that one of the library's own machines runs in polynomial time. Its proof only puts together the library's own closure lemmas (`machineCompose_mem_FP`, `machineIfHead_mem_FP`) with other lemmas of the library. Mathlib has no such machines and no FP class, so nothing there carries this content.
